statement: TSMC advanced packaging lines are reported as booked through 2027, and TSMC has responded competitively by announcing development of an EMIB-like packaging technology with Kinsus in late July 2026.
why: Packaging capacity sold out roughly two years forward is the clearest statement that advanced packaging, not wafer starts, caps AI accelerator supply.

impact.mechanism: Fully booked CoWoS lines mean incremental accelerator demand cannot be served until new capacity or an alternative packaging path comes online.

evidence.excerpt: TSMC's advanced packaging lines are described as 'booked through 2027.'

confidence.basis: Secondary trade reporting only; no primary TSMC disclosure in this document.
